THE PROJECT

An audiology platform connecting clinical patient management with a national hearing-health registry.

The challenge

Clinical teams need tools for individual patient care, while a registry serves a different purpose: understanding patterns in hearing health. The platform needs to support both without confusing their users or information access.

My contribution

I worked across the clinical and registry interfaces and their supporting backend, including data workflows, authentication, permissions and deployment.

A CLOSER LOOK
01

Two modules, distinct purposes

The patient management module supports clinical workflows. The registry is designed to expose authorised aggregate or de-identified information, rather than patient care records.

02

Access shaped by responsibilities

Roles and facility membership guide which parts of the platform a user can access. Clinical information and registry views follow distinct permission boundaries.

THE USER JOURNEY
  1. 01Enter the appropriate module
  2. 02Access authorised workflows
  3. 03Work with the relevant information
